definitions.explanation: A distinctive quality of dignity or refined character that a person, place, or thing possesses. Implies a sense of gravitas developed over time or through experience.

examples.japanese: {風格|ふうかく}のある{建物|たてもの}
{年|とし}を{重|かさ}ねて{風格|ふうかく}が{出|で}てきた。
examples.english: He has developed a distinguished presence with age.

examples.japanese: この{古|ふる}い{旅館|りょかん}には、{長|なが}い{歴史|れきし}に{裏打|うらう}ちされた{風格|ふうかく}がある。
examples.english: This old inn has a dignity backed by its long history.

notes:
NUANCE: {風格|ふうかく} suggests a distinctive quality that develops over time through experience, age, or history. It applies to both people and things (buildings, art, places).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {風格|ふうかく}がある/ない (to have/lack dignity)
- {風格|ふうかく}が{出|で}る (to develop character)
- {風格|ふうかく}を{備|そな}える (to possess dignity)
- {風格|ふうかく}のある{人|ひと}/{建物|たてもの} (a person/building with character)

RELATED WORDS:
- {威厳|いげん} (dignity - more imposing)
- {品格|ひんかく} (grace, refinement)
- {貫禄|かんろく} (presence - especially from experience)
- {佇|たたず}まい (atmosphere, bearing)
